identity_reason: it is a pattern built from PinInput, Spinner and Button, so its look comes from those and only its words are new
concept: The one-time-code step: where the code went, PinInput, the check, the error in words and a resend button that counts down.

root.why: the parts stack from the lead line to the resend row with an even gap

lead.why: the lead line is secondary at body size and says where the code went

to.why: the masked address is primary and medium weight and never breaks across lines

status.why: the status line says in words what happened and is announced politely

wrong.why: a wrong code turns the sentence primary so the error is read before anything else

glyph.why: a wrong code adds the critical diamond beside the sentence so it reads by shape

resend.why: the resend button sits apart under the status with its countdown beside it

wait.why: the countdown is secondary in tabular figures so it does not jitter each second
